components.name: Clock drum facade
components.function: Need curved wall/clock reveal host, balcony/stair return, dome/ring supports and rock-to-deck contacts. Clock/wave/metal ring vocabulary already present; rotating or illuminated behavior is separate optional work. Salt grasses/seaweed, seabirds/crabs/tide-pool fauna proposed; tide levels not solved. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.
components.construction: One isolated clock drum facade matching the supplied building, its roof/arch/wall silhouette and local materials. Show front and interior/rear/underside contact, not a complete building scene. Actual open column galleries and holes stay open. Extend hidden depth only enough to form a joinable section; no palace-wide plan or added unrelated tower.
components.attachment_face: Underside/root to ground or declared host; keep true openings clear
components.semantic_front: Main visible face +Y and Zup; sides are actual thickness, not flattened painting
components.design_basis: Visible source vocabulary with missing construction views or new habitat forms; metrics and hidden surfaces proposed
